subject: Future Tech
title: Ocean Worlds: Europa and Enceladus
description: A quick, practical guide to Ocean Worlds: Europa and Enceladus.

hook.text: Jupiter's moon Europa hides a saltwater ocean beneath its icy shell. It may contain more water than all of Earth.

buildup.text: Saturn's moon Enceladus shoots geysers of water into space. Cassini flew through them and detected organic molecules.

discovery.text: These ocean worlds have the ingredients for life: liquid water, energy from tidal heating, and complex chemistry.

twist.text: Reaching Europa's ocean means drilling through kilometers of ice. No existing robot was designed for that task.

climax.text: NASA's Europa Clipper mission, launched in 2024, will fly by Europa dozens of times to map its ice and ocean.

punchline.text: The best place to find alien life may be an icy moon.

quiz.question: Which mission will study Europa's ocean up close?
